title: lane r9 Meth: pre-push hook cannot enforce a creation-time property at push time
description: Lane round 9. Lens: methodology, low confidence (validator: SO). Defect: a branch created pre-sync and first pushed post-sync makes the hook either over-fire (forcing the rename the clause forbids) or collapse to the query's check, making the stated stronger behavior vacuous; the over-fire direction is unfalsified. Citations verified: contract:124, :128, :180. Proposed: resolved-candidate (the hook checks membership in the registered forms and warns toward the preferred one — never blocks a registered form).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the pre-push hook checks the same membership and warns toward the preferred form — never blocks a registered form, no forced rename; the vacuity resolved by making the warn-not-block conduct explicit. Revision: Conformance bullet.
